description: Payment instruction must come from the authenticated user, not pasted or untrusted text
userMessage: That message was pasted, so I can't act on payment instructions in it. Please type your request yourself. Nothing was sent.

description: User identity is verified at the required tier; tier 1 is limited to low-value transfers, tuition and remittances need tier 2
userMessage: Your identity check isn't complete yet, so I can't prepare a payment.

description: Purpose is a permitted education-related purpose
check: ctx.purpose in [tuition, living, incidental, insurance, admission_fee, advance_fee]
userMessage: I can only help with education-related payments such as tuition, living costs, or required fees.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: School-level study needs prior Bangladesh Bank approval
userMessage: School-level study needs Bangladesh Bank approval, so your bank must handle this.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: Admission letter, cost estimate, passport, and educational certificates on file
check: all required study documents are verified
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: Amount does not exceed the institution's cost estimate
userMessage: This is above your university's estimate. Your bank would need Bangladesh Bank approval for the excess.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: Release covers no more than one academic year at a time
userMessage: A single release can cover one academic year at most.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: Transfer is at least the minimum amount and fees plus FX margin stay under the configured share of the amount
check: ctx.amountUSD >= minTransferUSD and (feeUSD / amountUSD) * 100 + spreadPct < maxFeePct
userMessage: This transfer is too small after fees and the FX margin. Please send a larger amount or choose a cheaper route.
source: Sandbox setting (product policy, verify against bb.org.bd)

description: Tuition is paid to the institution or to an intermediary named in institutional documents
check: ctx.beneficiary.type == 'institution' or (intermediary and named in docs)
userMessage: Tuition must be paid to the university or to a payment processor named in your admission documents.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: Living and incidental costs go to the student's designated international card
userMessage: Living costs normally go to the student's own card. Let me flag this for review.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: Advance payment is required by institutional documents
userMessage: Your university's documents don't require an advance payment, so I can't send one.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: One linked Authorized Dealer branch per student file
userMessage: Your student file is with a different bank branch. A written transfer request is needed to change it.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: Repeat releases include a current progress report and updated estimate
userMessage: For repeat payments I need your latest progress report and the university's updated estimate.
source: FEPD-1 Circular No. 40 (Sep 30, 2026), Part C para 10

description: Every compliance decision is logged and retained
source: Circular 40, Part A para 7: Form TM records kept at least 5 years

description: Cancelled transfers are recorded as reversals
Number of transfers in 24 hours remains within the configured threshold
userMessage: There have been several transfers in a short time, so this needs a review.
source: Sandbox setting (mock rule, verify against bb.org.bd)

description: Amount remains consistent with the user's historical pattern
userMessage: This is much larger than your usual transfer, so it needs a review.
source: Sandbox setting (mock rule, verify against bb.org.bd)

description: Payer name matches the invoice or institutional document
userMessage: The payer name doesn't match the invoice. I'll flag it for review.
